digest.component_or_area: janitor approval & derisk: RP-02–RP-06 recovery decisions
propositions: Five approved Recovery Proposals (RP-02 through RP-06) derived from a 2026-08-16 recovered janitor plan require evidence-backed decision-ready briefs mapping architectural intent, hard-won behavior, and remaining maintainer-only choices before conversion to implementation stories.

RP-02 transaction semantics specify ordered exact-match retirement recovery at an explicit live-operation boundary, where the durable tombstone is the retirement intent and recovery removes the live forward/reverse pair only when identities exactly agree, with ambiguity or replacement failure triggering safety abort—an approved behavior delta from prior reload-as-simultaneous-live-and-retired handling.

RP-03 defines a two-level failure/retry pattern where concrete Jira adapters own request replay loops and provider error decoding, while the backend-neutral reconciler owns operation intent, commit_unknown write-ahead recovery, re-observation/re-planning, the scoped finite-pass fuse (3 consecutive exhausted logical outcomes across ≥2 tickets), and singular authoritative Jira rate scopes distinct from transient physical attempt classification.

RP-04 centralizes operation-authority composition through explicit CLI > environment > project > user > default precedence per operation, with separate secret/provider boundaries, non-secret subprocess envelope, central defaults, fail-closed malformed-config behavior, and removal of Cloud adapter-local fallback—explicitly correcting prior CLI-over-environment precedence and captured backend-settings capture.

RP-05 normalizes all 21 visible advanced CLI verbs onto side-effect-free, pre-operation package-data canonical help before handler loading, config materialization, or store mounting, with overview/canonical-help/alias/unknown routing preceding RP-04 operation-snapshot composition and exact aliases reusing canonical help while compatibility shims retain alias-specific guidance.

RP-06 approves effective applicability reversal (activated project criteria evaluated against effective routing policy, then run exactly once in Round A if selected, with disabled/non-applicable criteria run zero times), effective built-in/project-DET routing integration, authored explicit budget enforcement in plan-review gate, and parity-first current-run failure projection over failure-checkpoint transient-suppression correction.
